"""Reclassify retained native timing observations; never re-run live collection."""
import argparse
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from hashlib import sha256
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from src.workstation.events import Gap
from src.workstation.recording import RecordingReader

p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('input',type=Path)
p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
a=p.parse_args()
original_bytes=a.input.read_bytes()
r=json.loads(original_bytes)
native=r['native_report']
manifest=native['manifest']
capture=Path(native['capture'])
streams={s['stream_id'] for s in manifest['streams']}
clock=manifest['clock_id']
indexed=[(i,o) for i,o in enumerate(r['observations']) if o['stream_id'] in streams and o['processing']['clock_id']==clock]
keys=lambda o:(o['stream_id'],o['processing']['ingest_ordinal'],o['processing']['clock_id'],o['processing']['receive_mono_ns'])
observed=Counter(keys(o) for _,o in indexed)
raw_keys=Counter()
event_counts=Counter()
epochs=defaultdict(set)
with RecordingReader(capture,verify=True) as reader:
    for frame in reader.iter_raw():
        raw_keys[(str(frame.stream_id),int(frame.ingest_ordinal),str(frame.clock_id),int(frame.receive_mono_ns))]+=1
        epochs[str(frame.stream_id)].add(int(frame.connection_epoch))
    for batch in reader.iter_batches():
        event_counts.update(type(e.payload).__name__ for e in batch.events)
    verified_files=len(reader.manifest.files)
    assert reader.manifest.complete
first_valid={}
valid_categories={'cold_or_recovery_bootstrap','valid_incremental','valid_snapshot_or_reset'}
warm_categories={'valid_incremental','valid_snapshot_or_reset'}
for _,o in indexed:
    if o['category'] in valid_categories:
        first_valid[o['stream_id']]=min(first_valid.get(o['stream_id'],o['processing']['publish_mono_ns']),o['processing']['publish_mono_ns'])
ready=max(first_valid.values())
phases={
    'cold_or_recovery_bootstrap':[(i,o) for i,o in indexed if o['category']=='cold_or_recovery_bootstrap'],
    'warm_books_during_cohort_bootstrap':[(i,o) for i,o in indexed if o['category'] in warm_categories and o['processing']['receive_mono_ns']<ready],
    'normal_after_all_six_books_published':[(i,o) for i,o in indexed if o['category'] in warm_categories and o['processing']['receive_mono_ns']>=ready],
    'all_warm_books_including_cohort_bootstrap':[(i,o) for i,o in indexed if o['category'] in warm_categories],
}
def stats(values):
    values=sorted(values)
    return {'count':len(values),**{f'p{p}_ms':None if not values else values[math.ceil(len(values)*p/100)-1]/1e6 for p in (50,95,99)},'max_ms':None if not values else values[-1]/1e6}
def metrics(rows):
    out=defaultdict(list)
    for _,o in rows:
        t=o['processing']
        for name,begin,end in (
            ('receive_to_valid','receive_mono_ns','validation_end_mono_ns'),
            ('queue_residence','receive_mono_ns','queue_exit_mono_ns'),
            ('executor_wait','queue_exit_mono_ns','decode_start_mono_ns'),
            ('decode','decode_start_mono_ns','decode_end_mono_ns'),
            ('validation','decode_end_mono_ns','validation_end_mono_ns'),
            ('receive_to_normalized','receive_mono_ns','normalized_mono_ns')):
            assert t[end]>=t[begin]
            out[name].append(t[end]-t[begin])
        out['native_decode_reduce_thread_cpu'].append(o['native_decode_reduce_thread_cpu_ns'])
    return {name:stats(values) for name,values in out.items()}
phase_reports={name:{'timings':metrics(rows),'original_observation_indices':[i for i,_ in rows]} for name,rows in phases.items()}
normal=phases['normal_after_all_six_books_published']
normal_metric=phase_reports['normal_after_all_six_books_published']['timings']['receive_to_valid']
checks={
    'native_cli_complete':r['exit_code']==0 and native['status']=='complete' and manifest['complete'],
    'all_raw_receipts_observed_exactly_once':observed==raw_keys and all(v==1 for v in observed.values()),
    'no_recorded_gaps':event_counts.get('Gap',0)==0,
    'single_epoch_per_source':all(len(v)==1 for v in epochs.values()),
    'all_six_books_published':len(first_valid)==6,
    'no_capture_processing_errors':not any(e.get('stream') in streams for e in r['processing_errors']),
    'no_timestamp_errors':r['invalid_timestamp_observations']==0,
    'source_unchanged':r['source_before']==r['source_after'],
    'no_pending_processing':r['pending_results_at_shutdown']==0,
    'normal_original_p95_budget':normal_metric['p95_ms']<=25,
    'normal_original_p99_budget':normal_metric['p99_ms']<=100,
}
E={
    'schema':1,'completed':all(checks.values()),'script':Path(__file__).read_text(),'command':sys.argv,
    'input':str(a.input),'input_sha256':sha256(original_bytes).hexdigest(),
    'scope_correction':'The original class-wide wrapper also observed six discovery-probe clocks. All four cancellation records are outside the actual18-stream managed capture. The original overall attempt remains failed; this analysis independently verifies the recorded source scope, without recollecting data.',
    'normal_load_definition':'Receive time at or after the first native valid-book publication for every one of the six required order-book streams. The boundary is the maximum of those six first-publication timestamps, not an optimized fixed-duration trim or percentile-derived cutoff. Captured warm updates during cohort bootstrap remain separately reported. No recovery/epoch change or gap is allowed by this single-bootstrap analysis.',
    'boundary_limit':'Native publish_mono_ns is publication start, before consumer callbacks complete. This boundary may include early callback/backlog work; it does not claim synchronized browser readiness.',
    'capture':str(capture),'manifest_sha256':sha256((capture/'manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'capture_clock_id':clock,
    'source_revision':manifest['code_revision'],'verified_files':verified_files,'raw_receipts':sum(raw_keys.values()),'normalized_payload_counts':dict(event_counts),
    'discovery_observations_excluded_from_capture_scope':len(r['observations'])-len(indexed),
    'capture_observations':len(indexed),'original_missing_count':r['missing'],
    'missing_scope_proof':'Every persisted raw frame matches exactly one retained observation with identical stream, ordinal, clock and receive time; therefore global missing/cancelled probe observations did not omit a recorded source receipt.',
    'cohort_first_valid_publication_mono_ns':{k:str(v) for k,v in first_valid.items()},'cohort_ready_mono_ns':str(ready),
    'cohort_ready_after_first_capture_receipt_seconds':(ready-min(k[3] for k in raw_keys))/1e9,
    'phases':phase_reports,
    'normal_by_instrument':{instrument:metrics([(i,o) for i,o in normal if o['instrument_id']==instrument]) for instrument in sorted({o['instrument_id'] for _,o in normal})},
    'original_budget':{'p95_ms':25,'p99_ms':100,'unchanged':True,'observed':normal_metric},
    'checks':checks,
    'limitations':['Finite60-second public capture, not a statistical24-hour SLO or proof of maximum throughput.','All source observations and the failed unsegmented budget remain in the immutable input report; only scope/readiness classification is corrected.','Startup latency is not hidden: both cold bootstraps and committed warm-book backlog before cohort readiness are retained.','This proves native receive-to-validation completion, not venue timestamp age, downstream normalization/publication, recorder dispatch or browser paint.']}
with a.output.open('x') as f:
    json.dump(E,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
    f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'output':str(a.output),'completed':E['completed'],'checks':checks,'normal':normal_metric,'cohort_ready_seconds':E['cohort_ready_after_first_capture_receipt_seconds']}))
raise SystemExit(0 if E['completed'] else 1)
scope_correction: The original class-wide wrapper also observed six discovery-probe clocks. All four cancellation records are outside the actual18-stream managed capture. The original overall attempt remains failed; this analysis independently verifies the recorded source scope, without recollecting data.
normal_load_definition: Receive time at or after the first native valid-book publication for every one of the six required order-book streams. The boundary is the maximum of those six first-publication timestamps, not an optimized fixed-duration trim or percentile-derived cutoff. Captured warm updates during cohort bootstrap remain separately reported. No recovery/epoch change or gap is allowed by this single-bootstrap analysis.
boundary_limit: Native publish_mono_ns is publication start, before consumer callbacks complete. This boundary may include early callback/backlog work; it does not claim synchronized browser readiness.
missing_scope_proof: Every persisted raw frame matches exactly one retained observation with identical stream, ordinal, clock and receive time; therefore global missing/cancelled probe observations did not omit a recorded source receipt.
limitations: Finite60-second public capture, not a statistical24-hour SLO or proof of maximum throughput.
All source observations and the failed unsegmented budget remain in the immutable input report; only scope/readiness classification is corrected.
Startup latency is not hidden: both cold bootstraps and committed warm-book backlog before cohort readiness are retained.
This proves native receive-to-validation completion, not venue timestamp age, downstream normalization/publication, recorder dispatch or browser paint.
